name: BC5CDR: BioCreative V Chemical Disease Relation Corpus
description: The BC5CDR (BioCreative V Chemical-Disease Relation) corpus is a gold-standard biomedical text mining and named entity recognition (NER) benchmark developed by the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) for the BioCreative V challenge, published in the journal Database. The corpus consists of 1,500 PubMed abstracts (split into 500 training, 500 development, and 500 test articles) comprehensively annotated for chemical entity mentions, disease entity mentions, and chemical-induced disease (CID) relational interactions. Containing 12,850 chemical mentions, 12,413 disease mentions, and 3,116 distinct CID relations mapped to MeSH concepts, BC5CDR is the definitive benchmark for biomedical information extraction.
